title: Players.PlayerRemoving
summary: Fires just BEFORE a player leaves the server — the standard save hook. Pair with periodic saves and BindToClose; don't rely on it alone (crashes skip it).

details.heading: Timing
details.body: Fires while the Player object still exists (character may already be gone). After it returns, the Player is removed.

explanation.whatItIs: The checkout counter: last chance to save and clean up before someone leaves.
explanation.whyItExists: Data loss on exit is the classic multiplayer bug; this event is the designed countermeasure.
whenToUse: Saving player data (DataStore writes with pcall/retry)
whenNotToUse: As the SOLE save strategy — server crashes never fire it; add periodic saves + BindToClose
tips: Save synchronously here (no task.delay) so it completes before removal
game:BindToClose for shutdown-time saves of everyone still present
Keep a session cache so saves are cheap table writes
commonMistakes: task.wait/task.delay inside the handler — the player may be gone when it resumes
Assuming the event fires on server crash — it doesn't
Reading character state after it's already destroyed — capture data earlier

examples.title: Save-on-leave with BindToClose
examples.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function savePlayer(player)
    local data = sessionCache[player.UserId]
    if not data then return end
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        dataStore:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, data)
    end)
    if not ok then warn("Save failed for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err) end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(savePlayer)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
        savePlayer(player)
    end
end)
